summary.result: It was found that approximately 56.19 % of T-P could be reduced with vegetated filter strip of 5 m at the edge of agricultural fields within the watershed (34.86 % reduction with VFS of 1m, 48.29 % with VFS of 3 m).
summary.background: Mandae watershed in Gangwon province has been known as one of soil erosion hot spot watersheds within Hanggang basin.
